sections.title: II. Read the following passage and circle the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.introHtml:
Last summer, my class joined a volunteer program in a small village. We helped the villagers repair their houses, plant trees, and clean the environment. Every day we worked very hard, but we were happy because we helped people. The villagers were very kind and offered us local food. After a week, we felt tired but proud of our work.

This volunteer trip was a great experience for all of us. We learned how to work in a team and how to share with others. In the evenings, we played games and sang songs with the children in the village. They were friendly and always smiled. We also organized a small party on the last day to say goodbye. Everyone promised to come back next summer to help again. The trip taught us that helping others brings happiness to both people who give and those who receive.

sections.title: IV. Write a paragraph (70 words) about what you do to stay healthy. Some suggestions:

questions.html:
- eat a lot of fruits and vegetables

- drink plenty of water and avoid fast food and soft drinks

- go jogging and play badminton

- sleep at least eight hours a night.

The end
questions.referenceHtml:
1. Format: (0.1 point for correct format). One paragraph only with the introduction, the
body, and the conclusion.

2. Content: (0.4 point): a provision of main ideas and details as appropriate to the main idea.

3. Language: (0.3 point): a variety of vocabulary and structures appropriate to the level of
secondary students.

4. Presentation: (0.2 point): Coherence, cohesion and style appropriate to the level of
secondary students.
